title: f83r P2 complete exploratory amulet instructions: persistent stone, depiction versus physical part, and scoped enclosure
summary: RAW_UNREVIEWED, NOT SELECTED. New complete 84-group projected-paragraph descendant of RAW384. All five old meanings remain; 66 new whole-form guesses fill 70 old unknown positions under nine declared productions. The same eagle is depicted while an eagle-or-hawk physical part and the same grape seed are placed below the persistent stone. Early ENCLOSE is quoted by an explicit goal marker; later ENCLOSE executes after the placement branch. Three diplomatic ZL forms remain unbound. No tests or confirmed meanings.

decision_note.unknown: The bounded primary review found RAW384 only partially aligned, with 70 positions explicitly unknown. The source dossier already owns the full I.1.39 paragraph and its typed image/material consequence; merely repeating that consequence is not new. What is new here is a complete, freely guessed target program with fixed role, choice, goal and action bindings.
decision_note.changed_input: A new descendant supplies every projected group, nine whole-clause productions, exact reference/branch rules and action preconditions. No old parent, failure or source text is repaired. The old source law is reused, not advertised as newly discovered.
decision_note.pass_changes: Retain one internally coherent full projected-paragraph amulet working interpretation with both source material branches and all qualifications. A pass is not evidence of actual magic, source identity, a deciphered word or superiority to other coherent readings.
decision_note.failure_changes: Reject this fixed completed descendant if its parse, participant bindings, branch scope or action preconditions conflict. Do not rescue it by turning another occurrence into a goal, replacing a component, dropping an effect clause or remapping a raw form.
decision_note.smallest_test: Parse all 84 projected groups and all nine productions; compile the explicit material alternative and goal/imperative scopes; execute both E/H branches from the declared loose-material initial state with an independent typed graph implementation. Check every action, invariant and source claim, including the first ENCLOSE causing no sealing and the later ENCLOSE requiring both material pieces. Keep projection binding separate from semantic consistency. No general decoder or parameter search is necessary.
decision_note.producer_execution: NONE. Documentation and primary checks only; no tests, model execution or current-result inspection.

source.work: Cyranides I.1.39, complete final assembly/claim paragraph through alpha closure
source.owned_edition: Fernand de Mely 1898 as distributed by Open Greek and Latin / First1KGreek; late-antique/medieval compilation, no precise date certified for this individual passage.

exact_existing_section.text: Λαβὼν οὖν ἀετίτην λίθον γλύψον ἀετόν, καὶ ὑπὸ τὸν λίθον ὑπόθες γίγαρτον σταφυλῆς, καὶ τὸ ἄκρον τοῦ πτεροῦ τοῦ ἀετοῦ εἶτε ἱέρακος, καὶ κατακλείσας φόρει· διαφυλάξει σε γὰρ ἀπὸ πάντων τῶν (f. 12 v.) προειρημένων παθῶν. Ἔτι μὴν καὶ ἀξιόλογον καὶ προσφιλῇ συντυχίαις δυναστῶν, καὶ μεγάλων ἀνδρῶν καὶ περιεχόντων χάριν παρέξει· καὶ ἐπὶ ἑτέρων πολλῶν [ἄλλων] ὧν οὐ χρεία ἐστὶν λέγειν ποιήσει, καὶ οὕτως πέρας εἴληφεν τὸ πρῶτον στοιχεῖον ἄλφα.

source.license_and_attribution: Greek digital extract: Open Greek and Latin, First1KGreek, 1898 base edition, CC BY-SA 4.0. Existing source URL and license are retained from the parent dossier; no new download or image was used.
full_content_obligations: Take aetites stone and engrave an eagle.
Place grape seed below the stone.
Include an eagle wing/feather-tip or a hawk's corresponding part.
Claim protection against all previously mentioned ailments.
Claim favor/esteem in meetings with rulers, great people and people of standing.
Assert other unlisted effects and close the first alpha section.
limits: Wing-tip versus exact wing/feather-part sense remains unresolved.
All efficacy/social-success language is attributed historical claim, not a fact about an executed treatment.
The prior-ailment reference points to the same chapter's earlier sections; this card does not enumerate or invent that set.
I.1.39 is the complete chosen source paragraph, not all 39 sections or all Book I.
C02/C04 and the explicit goal/persistence explanation are analytical elaborations in this speculative reading; no exact or lossless Greek-to-Voynich translation is claimed.

complete_clauses.reduction: INSTRUCTION TAKE(S); GOAL(ENCLOSE(A), AS_AMULET(A), FOR_WEAR(A,W), FOR_PROTECTION(A,W)). The first ENCLOSE has the same operation denotation as C08, but GOAL quotes it and has no world-state effect.

complete_clauses.reduction: Declare representation and material-provenance schemas. OF(kind) under FORM describes depiction content; OF(body) under PHYSICAL_PART describes bodily provenance. These do not introduce the represented bird as an enclosed physical animal.
complete_clauses.source_relationship: Analytical elaboration of the source's distinct depiction/material roles; not an assertion that this explanatory sentence occurs verbatim in Greek.

grammar_contract.terminals: Every exact projected word and space is retained. One fixed lexical entry per whole form throughout all nine lines. No EVA component meaning, phonetic rule, silent filler or arbitrary skipped token.
grammar_contract.productions: Exactly the nine terminal-tag sequences printed in complete_clauses, in the nine inherited line positions, with the stated reductions. These are nine freely fitted clause schemas, not a learned general language or an independent statistical constraint.
grammar_contract.compile_before_execute: First resolve declarations, types, goal expressions, the C06/C07 alternative and anaphoric references from the complete program. Then execute its imperative plan. Declarative REQUIRE_POSITION and RETAIN are not performed placements or second engravings. A mentioned future physical component does not appear inside the assembly before placement.
grammar_contract.goal_scope: GOAL in C01 governs ENCLOSE and its AS_AMULET/FOR_WEAR/FOR_PROTECTION complements only. It records the same operation as later ENCLOSE but does not execute it. No other word or occurrence receives a goal exemption.
grammar_contract.choice_scope: ALTERNATIVELY in C07 joins exactly C06 and C07 as the two values of material bird-kind(P). Exactly one branch executes. It does not replace the depicted eagle, change the seed/wearer/stone or cause both bird parts to be installed.
grammar_contract.actor_elision: There is one instruction addressee W, identical to both explicit WEARER occurrences and YOU. C07 and the imperatives in C01/C08 inherit this actor. No second hidden person is introduced.
reference_resolution: THE_ENGRAVING is the unique I produced by ENGRAVE_ON(S,IMAGE_OF(E)).
ITS_CARRIER, THERE and THE_STONE resolve S; SAME enforces identity, not merely stone kind.
SELECTED BIRD_PART creates component role P; C06/C07 resolve its provenance to E or H.
THAT_PART in C07 resolves this MaterialPart role, never the Depiction role I.
THAT_ASSEMBLY resolves A, which contains the same S and the selected physical components.
ALL_PREVIOUS AILMENTS remains a source chapter backreference, not a free disease-choice parameter.
recurring_new_forms: aiin=OF at both .10 positions; typed arguments distinguish representation provenance from material provenance.
dal=WITH at both .14 positions; groups distinct materials or accompanies the carrier, without fusing them.
shcthy=PLACES at .14 and .15; same pose-consuming operation in the two material alternatives.
grammar_contract.inverse: Keep a source locator for every terminal and reduction. An exact projected-text inverse checks coverage only; it cannot prove the proposed meanings or settle three raw forms.
grammar_contract.uniform_WITH: Both dal tokens denote the same binary accompaniment relation WITH(left,right). C06 has WITH(P,G) as the material group and WITH(group,S) as its carrier frame. The fixed clause production assigns those typed argument positions; neither WITH occurrence executes placement or fuses objects.

entities.P: one physical wing/feather-tip component, source kind chosen E or H
entities.I: one depiction record hosted on S and representing E
entities.A: one planned composite amulet with S,G,P; distinct from S

semantic_contract.initial_state: S is available, unengraved and not enclosed. G and one part appropriate to the selected source branch are available as loose material. W is the addressee. A is a plan identifier with no executed assembly, enclosure or wearing yet. Source material availability and one actor are declared assumptions, not observations of f83r.

typed_OF.Form+BirdKind: representation-content relation only; no bird body or material is created
typed_OF.MaterialPart+BirdBody: physical provenance from a body of the selected bird kind; does not change what I depicts
typed_OF.limit: A depiction may have a physical carrier; the type distinction does not assert that all images are metaphysically immaterial. It prevents the represented bird from counting as the detachable ingredient.

operations.TAKE: Require a loose available physical object; put it into W's working possession. Do not change its identity or kind.
operations.IMAGE_OF: Construct a Depiction value of the argument BirdKind. It is not a MaterialPart.
operations.ENGRAVE_ON: Require S taken and not enclosed; host I on S with depicted_kind(I)=E. S persists.
operations.REQUIRE_UNDER: Store one intended placement relation UNDER(item,S); no world placement occurs.
operations.PREPARE_ITEMS: Check that the branch-selected P and the same G are available loose to W. This is an executable availability precondition, not a separate ownership/identity mutation. A missing material fails it; a repeated name never creates another item.
operations.PLACES: Require each item to be MaterialObject, loose, available, and to have exactly one resolved pose relative to S. Apply its UNDER relation and record it as an assembled component with S. In C07 UNDER_CARRIER spells the same pose explicitly. S,G,P remain distinct.
operations.ENCLOSE: Require S with its eagle depiction and both G/P already placed below it. Close assembly A around exactly those components; cannot consume I as the bird-part material. Does not replace S, G, P or I.
operations.GOAL: Quote a typed operation plus purpose predicates into the instruction specification. It has no physical-world effect; the same ENCLOSE denotation is later applied under THEN.
operations.WEAR: Require A enclosed; set worn_by(A)=W. The wearer does not become a component.
operations.CLAIM: Append an attributed proposition to a claim record. Never infer actual protection, medical cure or social favor from this bookkeeping.
operations.CLOSE_SECTION: Close the named text section, not the physical assembly.
operations.PREPARE: Check availability of the named loose material to W; pending spatial requirements are separately supplied by REQUIRE_UNDER. This check creates no extra physical object or preparation-state flag.

mandatory_relations: host(I)=S and depicted_kind(I)=E survive both branches.
UNDER(G,S) and UNDER(P,S) hold before executed enclosure.
components(A)={S,G,P}; image I is hosted by S rather than a substituted loose bird part.
C06/C07 chooses exactly one bird-part provenance; G/S/W identities do not vary with that choice.
Goal ENCLOSE does not set enclosed(A); executed ENCLOSE does.
All source effect and closure clauses are consumed without treating unlisted effects as invented explicit properties.
semantic_contract.anatomical_uncertainty: The part category stays WING_OR_FEATHER_TIP in the semantic record. The difference is not needed to decide depiction-versus-part or E/H substitution, and this model does not choose one precise anatomy.
semantic_contract.instruction_not_history: Simulation asks what would result if the whole proposed recipe were followed. The target hypothesis need not assert that any person actually made or wore such an object.
state_fields: identity/kind of physical S,G,P and actor W
semantic_contract.assembly_identity: At compilation A receives planned_components={S,G,P}. This is a requirement, not an assertion of physical assembly. PLACES supplies actual poses and assembled_components; only then can ENCLOSE set enclosed(A). The selected P has one physical identity within each branch; E/H branches are alternative executions, not the same object changing species.
semantic_contract.order: The imperative plan is TAKE(S), ENGRAVE_ON(S,IMAGE_OF(E)), common availability/pose requirements, exactly one material-placement branch, ENCLOSE(A), WEAR(W,A), attributed claims and section closure. Declarations in C02/C04/C05 constrain this whole plan without creating extra physical events. C06 and C07 differ in an explicit availability check as written, but both require availability in PLACES and have the same final physical structure apart from P provenance.

predeclared_full_consequences_not_execut.reused_input: shedy=E in C03 IMAGE_OF(E), C05 preserved image and C06 WING_TIP_OF(E)
predeclared_full_consequences_not_execut.prediction: The same bird-kind input has a depiction output I and a physical-provenance output P through different explicit constructors. I cannot satisfy the physical-component requirement merely because both name E.
C01 records a goal while A remains open/unassembled; only C08 may set enclosure after placement. Treating the first occurrence as executed enclosure fails the declared physical preconditions.
Both complete branches leave the same G below the same S and preserve the same wearer/image. They differ only in P's source bird kind E versus H.
The carved carrier is the one later assembled and worn. Repeated seed mentions never create extra G objects; the alternative branch still uses that same G.
If followed: S depicts E; G and P_E are beneath S and enclosed in A; W wears A. The attributed protection/social claims and alpha closure are recorded, not verified.
If followed: S still depicts E, but enclosed physical part is P_H. All other identities, assembly relations, attributed claims and closure remain the same.
